title: D-091: Linux recertification of the supervisor after M0-T177 and M0-T178 (supersedes M0-T174)
objective: Recertify the supervisor controller on this Linux server at the tree that includes M0-T177 (B-027 systemd control-group containment and the self-kill fix) and M0-T178 (DB-103 equal-model refusal): pin the certified tools/agent_supervisor tree hash and the installed CLI identities, re-run the live claude-version teeth (capability_probe for claude and codex, native_adapter, event_bus S8), the shell-routing harness with mutants and the Linux containment suite, cite the CI real-unit R3 proof and the windows freeze baseline, recapture all three claude drift families (capability probe, native-runtime detection, hook-event catalog) at the installed claude version because the host CLI moved from 2.1.287 to 2.1.288 (a deliberate admission event under D-024-R287; old fixtures kept) and re-point event_drift.py to the recaptured catalog, and write the certification report superseding M0-T174. All local probes; no provider call; no owner-typed step.
